title: hdnom 6.1.0
text: Updated functions code examples work glmnet >= 4.1-9 (#20). Specifically, compare_by_validate() compare_by_calibrate() now gain new argument rule selecting lambda glmnet models defaults lambda.min. Previously, tunable defaulted lambda.1se. Code examples involving glmnet models updated use lambda.min rule instead lambda.1se won’t generate null models. glmnet 4.1-9, using lambda.1se rule choosing lambda Cox model cross-validation results can generate null models easily. Previously, cross-validation errors Cox models normalized sum weights times event indicators per fold. glmnet 4.1-9, cross-validation errors normalized sum weights per fold. change means CV errors divided larger values (since censored observations now contribute normalization), produces smaller CV error values potentially smaller standard errors. make 1SE rule conservative lead selecting larger penalty values, hence sparser models complete null models. particularly affects datasets low event rates many censored observations, denominator change significant.

title: hdnom 6.0.0
text: Renamed exported functions. exported function renamed meaningful succinct. example, hdcox.*() renamed fit_*(), hdnom.nomogram() renamed as_nomogram(), hdnom.validate() renamed validate(), . Removed dependency rms, reusing minimal set code rms nomogram construction plotting. results clearer code structure, better maintainability, faster package installation/loading speed. Also removed non-essential package dependencies. first argument print functions now returned invisbily, make easier use pipe.

title: hdnom 6.0.0
text: components model fitting function returns now unified across model types. example, model object can accessed fit$model, selected “optimal” hyperparameters can accessed fit$lambda. model type now stored explicitly fit$type.

title: hdnom 6.0.0
text: as_nomogram (previously hdnom.nomogram()) now accepts fitted model objects directly instead $model component. now recognize model type automatically, thus previous arguments model.type deprecated. easier chain function calls together using magrittr. as_nomogram, previous ddist argument needed anymore removed. also need set datadist object global options variable (required rms user flow). new nomogram implementation prints plots nomogram penalized regression models directly. supersedes old implementation, fits OLS model regress linear predictors set predictors selected penalized Cox regression model, aiming approximate penalized model. numerical visual difference minimal, though.
